name: Tibet Kitchen
why_it_matters: The institutional Tibetan kitchen of McLeod Ganj — three storeys near the Main Square, almost always full. One of the few places in India that runs a real Bhutanese section: ema datshi, shepta, gundruk sadeko alongside the standard thukpa-momo set.
insider_tip: Order shabalay (fried meat pie) with sepen chilli sauce — it's the dish locals reorder. The mutton momos sell out by 8pm in season; go early if you want them.
signature_address: House #1, Main Square, Jogiwara Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Lung Ta Japanese Restaurant
why_it_matters: Set up in the late 1990s by Japanese expats as a not-for-profit kitchen supporting former Tibetan prisoners of conscience. Profits go to the cause; the food — a different complete vegetarian Japanese set every weekday — is a cult favourite among long-stay travellers.
insider_tip: Closed Sundays. The day's set is fixed and changes daily — there's no à la carte. Arrive by 12:30pm; the small dining room fills fast and they don't take bookings.
signature_address: Jogiwara Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Common Ground Cafe
why_it_matters: A social-enterprise cafe on the Tushita Road back-route from Dharamkot down to McLeod Ganj — fusion of Tibetan, Chinese and Taiwanese cooking, doubling as a community gathering point and event venue. The interior is full of books, old maps and pictures.
insider_tip: It's on the foot-trail between Tushita Meditation Centre and the main square — combine it with a morning meditation drop-in or use it as the lunch stop on the Dharamkot-McLeod walk.
signature_address: Tushita Road, Dharamkot, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Carpe Diem
why_it_matters: A long-running rooftop multi-cuisine kitchen on Jogiwara Road, opposite the TCV shop. Pizzas and Mexican are the strongest sections; portions are large and the floor cushions on the terrace are the seat travellers fight for.
insider_tip: Skip the Tibetan side of the menu — Norling and Tibet Kitchen do it better. Carpe Diem's strength is the Italian and Mexican. Open till 10:30pm, one of the latest kitchens in town.
signature_address: Jogiwara Road, below Post Office, opposite TCV Shop, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: The Chocolate Log
why_it_matters: Opened 31 January 1989 by Cheryl Templeton — one of the oldest patisserie cafes in McLeod Ganj. Three-plus decades of the same chocolate log cake, carrot-cinnamon cake and homemade apple pie. Quiet old-Mcleod feel; live music some evenings.
insider_tip: It's beside Carpe Diem on Jogiwara Road but easy to miss — the entrance is a small staircase. The chocolate log slice and a pot of tea is the standard order; everything else is built around it.
signature_address: Jogiwara Road, beside Carpe Diem, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Norling Restaurant
why_it_matters: A tiny family-run room at Dolma Chowk — the intersection of Jogiwara Road and Temple Road. Run by Mrs. Tenzin who walks new diners through the menu in person. Locals consistently call it the best momo plate in McLeod Ganj.
insider_tip: The mutton momos are the dish — order them steamed first, then a half-plate fried if you want the comparison. Vegetable thukpa at ₹110 is the cold-weather staple.
signature_address: Dolma Chowk, Jogiwara Road & Temple Road junction, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Nick's Italian Kitchen
why_it_matters: The all-vegetarian Italian kitchen attached to Kunga Guest House on Bhagsu Road — central, calm, one of the few sit-down-with-mountain-view rooms in town. Long breakfast menu (pancakes, porridge, fruit-and-muesli) and a strong fresh-pasta section.
insider_tip: Open 7:30am-8:30pm. Get there before 9am for the breakfast queue or after 3pm for the calm window. The huge outdoor terrace faces the valley — ask for a corner table.
signature_address: Kunga Guest House, Bhagsu Naag Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Jimmy's Italian Kitchen
why_it_matters: Family-run Italian kitchen on Bhagsu Road since 2001 — homemade cakes, bread, pasta and pizza sauce. First-floor terrace, two minutes from the main square. The other half of the McLeod Ganj Italian-pizza axis (the other being Nick's).
insider_tip: The wood-fired pizzas are the order; pasta is hit-or-miss. Honey-lemon-ginger tea is the local cure for the early-morning Triund-trek chill — most travellers add it to the bill.
signature_address: 1st Floor, Bhagsu Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Snow Lion Restaurant
why_it_matters: Airy, clean Tibetan room sitting in the middle of Jogiwara Road, attached to the Snow Lion guesthouse. Strong gluten-free and vegan side, home-baked cakes, home-brewed flavoured kombucha — rare in McLeod Ganj. A long-running base for Tushita meditation crowd.
insider_tip: Ask for the kombucha of the day — it's brewed on premises and the flavour rotates. The owner accommodates allergies; flag gluten-free or vegan when you order, not when the dish lands.
signature_address: Jogiwara Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Moonpeak Espresso
why_it_matters: Cult cafe on Temple Road, a few minutes from the Tsuglagkhang complex — widely cited as one of the first proper espresso bars in Little Lhasa and still among the strongest cups in town. Imaginative kitchen running a rotating Himachali side: mutton-apricot curry, roasted aubergine with tomato coulis.
insider_tip: Order the open brown-bread sandwich plus a single espresso — the signature combination. Window seats face the valley; the room is small so go off-peak (3-5pm).
signature_address: Temple Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Illiterati Books and Coffee
why_it_matters: Cliffside book-cafe on lower Jogiwara Road — three side balconies face the Dhauladhar range, the interior holds a hand-picked library across multiple languages, and there's a piano played at sunset. The single most photographed cafe view in McLeod Ganj.
insider_tip: If you spot a book in their wishlist (posted on the wall) and bring it next visit, the meal is on the house. Arrive 5pm for the sunset window, but expect a queue for balcony seats.
signature_address: Lower Jogiwara Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Cafe Budan
why_it_matters: Specialty-coffee room on Jogiwara Road — the bar most reviewers reach for when they say 'best coffee in Himachal'. Soy-milk option, mostly-vegan cake counter, tisanes brewed from real chamomile and hibiscus flowers rather than tea bags.
insider_tip: It's tiny — four-five tables. Off-peak window is 9-11am after the Triund crowd has left. Beans are roasted for filter, not espresso; ask for the V60 or AeroPress.
signature_address: Jogiwara Road, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Trek and Dine
must_try: waffles with chocolate cream and banana
why_it_matters: Dharamkot's de-facto living room — two-floor cafe right beside the Dharamkot taxi stand, on the foot of the Triund route. Israeli-and-Mexican leaning menu, decent wifi, late-night beer service upstairs. The pre-trek breakfast and post-trek beer crowd both end up here.
insider_tip: Upstairs is the seat to claim — open till the wee hours and the only place in upper McLeod with real wifi after 10pm. The make-your-own waffle is the order returnees keep coming back for.
signature_address: Next to Taxi Stand, Dharamkot, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Shiva Cafe
why_it_matters: Cult open-air cafe perched above Bhagsu waterfall — reach it via a 20-30 minute stair-and-rock climb past the falls. Shiva graffiti on the walls, paintings by long-stay travellers, a soundtrack of trance and classic rock. Functions as the de-facto rest stop on the alternate Triund-via-Bhagsu trail.
insider_tip: Cash only and slow service — order chai and one snack, not a meal. The trek up takes 25 minutes from the waterfall pool; sturdy shoes required after rain. Closes around sunset.
signature_address: Above Bhagsu Waterfall, Bhagsu Nag, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219

name: Namgyal Cafe
why_it_matters: Originally inside the Tsuglagkhang (Dalai Lama temple) compound, now relocated into Om Hotel on Nowrojee Road off the Main Square. Wood-fired pizzas with valley views, a small Tibetan section, and a books-and-coffee corner — the closest sit-down kitchen to the Namgyal Monastery.
insider_tip: The Om Hotel terrace catches the McLeod Ganj sunset. Order pizza and chai, not the full Tibetan menu — that's where the kitchen is sharpest. Walk-in only; no bookings.
signature_address: Om Hotel, Nowrojee Road, Main Square, McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh 176219
